title: Current authority reconciliation
decision: Use AGENTS.md plus governance/project_state.json and live branch/PR state as the active execution authority. Retired historical gate files are not prerequisites when project_state marks them retired.
rationale: The active branch records NO_PROJECT_SECURITY_GATE and the historical policy file is absent by design. Stale references in older handoff/checklist text must not turn the feature branch read-only.
